what: Reference sheets for tools/vehicles/fit (br-bwju.5): Muse Image turnarounds (art/ui/frames/generate.mjs --prompt refs/prompts/<sheet>.txt; ledger art/ui/frames/ledger.jsonl). Views are [x0, y0, x1, y1] windows on the 1920x1280 sheets, one view each. A bike's sheets need `segment.bright` (white helmet, silver racks), a small `open` (thin forks) and `keep` (parts joined by a few pixels).
cameraNote: Frozen diagnostic cameras: horizontal end views at bounding-box midpoint with long lens; identical mask/shading perspective. Generated refs are not calibrated photography. Side/top at 10 m. Baseline recaptured under these cameras before model edits.
segmentationNote: 2026-10-25 inspection: original rear crop at y820 cut half the helmet; original top crop at x1600 cut the right hand guard. Widened windows restore those photographed parts. Explicit exclusions remove the adjacent top-view front tyre from rear and adjacent rear-view helmet from top. dark=.65 restores silver forks/silencer that dark=.3 lost against the .85+ grey backdrop. Original masks and same-camera original baseline sheets preserved in docs/evidence/P1-V-roster-reference/pig-catcher/original-*. Updated baseline/current are both recaptured against identical corrected masks; wheel holes have separate geometry ray gates because silhouette fill intentionally fills enclosed holes.
